@Vanish251Project.recovery : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing S] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {α : S},
  (Polynomial.aeval α) f = 0 →
    ∀ {W' W'' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {j : σ →₀ ℕ},
      Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W') %ₘ f = Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W'') %ₘ f →
        (eval fun x ↦ α) ((hasseDeriv j) ((map (Int.castRingHom S)) (W' - W''))) = 0
